summary.text: Suzette Martinez Valladares represents District 23 in the California State Senate; her Senate biography says she was elected to the State Assembly in 2020 and the State Senate in 2024.

paragraphs.text: She is the former executive director of Southern California Autism Speaks and has managed an early childcare center; she attended College of the Canyons and transferred to CSU Northridge.
She lives in Acton with her husband and daughter.
